name: std::swap(std::packaged_task)
intro: Specializes the std::swap algorithm for std::packaged_task. Exchanges the state of lhs with that of rhs. Effectively calls lhs.swap(rhs).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
lhs, rhs
